input.title: Astronomers capture sharpest image yet of black hole's shadow
input.snippet: The Event Horizon Telescope collaboration released a new image of the supermassive black hole in M87, revealing unprecedented detail in the photon ring.

input.title: Potentially habitable exoplanet found around nearby red dwarf
input.snippet: Astronomers report a rocky exoplanet in the habitable zone of a star just 40 light-years away, a prime target for atmospheric follow-up.

input.title: Mercury retrograde: what it means for your love life this month
input.snippet: Astrologers say communication breakdowns are likely as Mercury appears to move backward. Here's how each sign can cope.

input.title: NASA delays Artemis II crewed Moon mission
input.snippet: NASA announced the Artemis II crewed lunar flyby is slipping to next year pending heat-shield analysis.

input.title: Local bakery launches galaxy-glazed donut for eclipse weekend
input.snippet: A Minneapolis bakery is selling purple galaxy donuts to celebrate the partial solar eclipse visible this weekend.

input.title: Webb detects water vapor in atmosphere of distant exoplanet K2-18b
input.snippet: JWST transmission spectroscopy found water vapor and carbon-bearing molecules in the atmosphere of the sub-Neptune K2-18b.

input.title: Study finds cheese consumption correlates with meteor sightings, scientists baffled
input.snippet: A viral preprint claims a correlation between cheese sales and fireball reports. Statisticians note the study has n=12 and no controls.

input.title: SpaceX Starship completes successful orbital test flight
input.snippet: Starship lifted off, completed a full orbital profile, and splashed down on target in the Indian Ocean.

input.title: Astrology app raises $50M to personalize horoscopes with AI
input.snippet: The startup says its model writes hyper-personalized daily horoscopes. Astronomers were not consulted.

input.title: Astronomers detect repeating fast radio burst from distant galaxy
input.snippet: A repeating fast radio burst traced to a galaxy 3 billion light-years away is helping map magnetic fields in intergalactic space.

input.title: Eclipse chasers flock to Iceland for rare total solar eclipse
input.snippet: Tens of thousands traveled to Iceland's south coast as the Moon fully covered the Sun for two minutes of totality.

input.title: NASA-branded sneakers sell out in minutes
input.snippet: A streetwear brand's NASA-logo sneakers sold out instantly. NASA receives no royalties under its merchandise guidelines.
